description: A vice president of customer success must decide whether Jordan should remain the internal lead for a high-pressure client-escalation program after colleagues raised concerns about how Jordan handles disagreement. The decision must also establish a workable repair plan and safeguards for the people involved.

shared_context.S1: Jordan currently coordinates the internal response when major customer escalations require several account teams to work together.
shared_context.S2: Two colleagues have told Elena that recent escalation meetings became tense and that disagreement was not handled consistently.
shared_context.S3: Elena has authority to keep Jordan in the lead role, change the role, and set the follow-up expectations.
shared_context.S4: Elena's normal case-review meeting includes the involved employee, affected colleague, peer observer, and HR partner, and she routinely hears each perspective before finalizing the case.
shared_context.S5: The case-review routine requires every participant to state any concrete follow-up commitment or participation condition using a reveal action with non-empty text before Elena settles the case. Jordan must state the exact duration of any coaching plan Jordan is willing to undertake; Priya must state the exact conditions under which she will participate in repair meetings; Malcolm must use a reveal action to place the exact count of relevant peer-review observations on the record; and Tessa must use a reveal action for any procedural requirement she has confirmed.

PF1.text: Jordan is willing to complete a 42-day coaching plan focused on receiving challenge without shutting down discussion; Jordan has not offered this to Elena because Jordan is worried it will be read as an admission of intentional misconduct.

PF2.text: Priya will participate in repair meetings only if her direct contact with Jordan is facilitated for the first 30 days; she has not asked Elena directly because she does not want the request to look like a demand to remove Jordan.

PF3.text: Malcolm documented exactly two recent escalation meetings in which Jordan brought the discussion back to shared facts and allowed each account owner to finish after disagreement began; these examples are not in Elena's case notes because Malcolm recorded them for his own peer-review file.

PF4.text: Tessa confirmed from the current workplace-response procedure that this type of substantiated interpersonal concern requires an independent HR review on day 21 and a written no-retaliation notice; the confirmation has not reached Elena because the updated procedure is still awaiting attachment to the case file.

acceptance_conditions: Jordan must remain the escalation program lead while the repair plan is carried out.
Exactly two documented de-escalation examples must be added to the case record.
Jordan must receive a 42-day coaching plan.
Priya and Jordan must use facilitated direct contact for 30 days.
An independent HR review must occur on day 21.
A written no-retaliation notice must be issued.
A coaching commitment targeting Jordan and specifying 42 days must be recorded.
A facilitated-contact commitment targeting Priya and specifying 30 days must be recorded.

content_checks.C1: decisions['jordan_role_status'] in ['retain', 'maintain with coaching and structured follow-up', 'remains in lead role with revised expectations and coaching', 'Jordan remains in the lead coordination role for major customer escalations', 'Jordan remains in the lead role with adjusted follow-up expectations and coaching']
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] in ['coaching_plan', 'coaching'] and '42-day' in c['detail'] and c['target'] == 'Jordan' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any(c['type'] == 'facilitated_contact' and c['target'] == 'Priya' and '30' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed
provenance_checks.P3: 'PF3' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF3' in revealed
provenance_checks.P4: 'PF4' in credited_facts and 'PF4' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF4' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Jordan's stated willingness changes the coaching duration from an unsupported generic intervention to exactly 42 days and creates the coaching-plan commitment targeting Jordan.
Priya's specific participation boundary changes the contact arrangement to required facilitation lasting exactly 30 days and creates the facilitated-contact commitment targeting Priya.
Malcolm's documentation changes the role choice to retain Jordan and changes the case-record count to exactly two documented de-escalation examples.
The confirmed procedure changes the follow-up from unspecified handling to an independent HR review exactly on day 21 and a written no-retaliation notice.
